notes.title: Anniversary Update spotted!
notes.content:
Greetings, dearest players!
With the release of Astrodogs for the Switch being complete, we're now working on bringing the improvements over to the PC version. 

We hope this gives you a chance to revisit your dear puppies!

Our anniversary patch will feature all improvements from the Switch version and more!

-Rebalanced all levels and boss fights
-Added level select
-Control adjustments
-Better performance
-Ship Movement Sensitivity slider to better adapt to your taste


Thank you all so much for being a part of Astrodogs, and stay tuned for more news regarding our next project! <3
